description: Read-only keyword search over the full text of active published English Nebula blog posts (not titles only). Use this when you need to discover which article to open with nebula_get_blog; use nebula_search_knowledge instead for the wider knowledge base. Ranking is deterministic term scoring (title > excerpt > body). Returns results[{title, slug, canonicalUrl, excerpt, matchedSnippet, datePublished, dateModified, score}], query, total. When the page is shortened to fit the size cap, truncated is true and nextOffset continues the ranked list. Arabic (/ar/) and excluded posts are never returned.

offset.description: First result index when continuing a truncated page (default 0)

query.description: Search words or a short question, e.g. "AI SEO for manufacturing exporters"

name: nebula_search_blog
title: Search Nebula blog
